rule: These are source-bound reconciliation candidates or boundary questions only. `rsr03:*` IDs are bookkeeping IDs, not canonical ingredient/recipe/creature IDs.

uncertainties_and_boundaries.detail: Filename says Sharra while visible saved content is Kola-Ha Formcraft/Warforms; do not retitle the retained source or infer omitted context.
Forms/Warforms are installed bioengineered capabilities in the recovered material, not automatically ingredients, harvest outputs or edible/alchemical parts.
Owner explicitly requested Warforms cost more and be more straining; exact generated values/effects remain proposals and belong to biotech/supernatural/character-system owners, not ICF formulas.
Blood Tree DCs, yield dice, potion/fuel/catalyst uses and failure effects are assistant-generated; preserve as candidate evidence without canonicalization.
Crafting bonuses/XP buy-ins are profession/progression rules; route to DPL/character systems. ICF may later supply typed recipe/material inputs only.
Medicine/alchemy organization prose is cultural/institutional context and does not define ICF formulas or ingredients.
Owner establishes prosperity/subsidy; assistant food-abundance interpretation is economy/world context. Do not infer ingredient availability, market price or production yield.
Owner requires mana types with sources/value/effects/rarity, but supernatural mana resources are not automatically ICF ingredients. Route to RSR-07/MSS.
Genetic-material harvesting in assistant prose is biotech/history, not enough evidence to create ICF biological ingredient outputs.

Cooking levels, crafting tiers and recipe discovery are assistant proposals for gamified-reality progression; ICF owns recipe/material content semantics, not the Reality Kernel or progression authority.
Cross-reality cuisine context supports later recipe-template design but supplies no named ingredient or recipe that may be invented in RSR-03.
